failures.evidence:
The title-line allow-list (title_lines.go htmlBlockOpens) admits as text some lines that Go's reader (goldmark v1.8.6, parser/html_block.go) opens an HTML block at: '<meta' (goldmark's allowedBlockTags holds 'meta'; blockHTMLNames does not), '</ div>' and '</ p' (goldmark's type 6/7 patterns allow spaces after '</'; htmlTagName does not), '<pre/>', '<script/>x' and '<pre' + form feed (goldmark's type 1 opens on '/>' and on \s, which holds \f; the allow-list's raw-element rule does not). Such a title line is written raw, Go reads the stored markdown back otherwise, and the write is refused. Real API (harness/live.sh, the real Go server and Postgres; tester/live-tg4head.out vs live-tg4base.out): POST /api/v1/issues/LIVE-1/artifacts with '[![x](i.png)](https://u.com "a
<meta
z")', the same with '</ div>', '<pre/>' and '<META x=\"1\">', top level and in a list item -> head HTTP 400 INVALID_MARKDOWN 'the markdown the document would be stored as reads back otherwise' (7 of 8; the list-item <pre/> is taken), main d1f4b8a6 HTTP 201 (it stores '![x](i.png)', dropping the link). The control title 'a
b
z' is taken at both. The same lines in an image's own title are refused at main and head alike, a refusal caused by how an image title is written, so per the architect's rule (envoy b7c8fbfe) they are this change's to fix too. differential.sh --base d1f4b8a6 --head 7270f77d over 11,630 documents: GATE head refuses a write the base takes 137 and GATE head loses a whole-image link 137, every one in my corpora (fuzz-t10 128, titles-r6 9) and every one with such a line; 138 of the 140 'linked image in a write both refuse' rows are refused for the same reason ('reads back otherwise'), so they are not outside the image fields. Red test TestParseTakesAnImageTitleLineGoReadsAsAnHTMLBlock in packages/envoy/internal/dispatch/pmdoc/parse_test.go, commit b3358e383fe39002e6c034f734608e63f2af1698, fails with `cd packages/envoy && go test ./internal/dispatch/pmdoc/ -run TestParseTakesAnImageTitleLineGoReadsAsAnHTMLBlock` (52 of 56 rows: 'want the write taken'); a copy passes at 733ebfdb, which wrote such titles 
. The committed fuzz.ts does not reach these lines: its rows at the head show none of the 137.

checked: The other 2 of the 140 'linked image in a write both refuse' rows (fuzz:2353, fuzz:3927) are refused while reading the source as written, before any rendering ('a footnote definition whose label holds whitespace' and 'typed block directives use :::name{...}'): fuzz.ts writes those titles' line feeds raw, so the input's own lines make a footnote definition and a malformed directive. Not caused by how the writer writes an image field; they stay ungated.

How I found the failure: I diffed goldmark's HTML block rules and tag list (parser/html_block.go) and micromark's (html-flow.js, micromark-util-html-tag-name) against title_lines.go. goldmark-only tag: meta; goldmark also accepts '</ ' with spaces and opens raw elements on '/>' and form feed. micromark's raw open on '/' falls through to a complete tag, which the allow-list already escapes at a lazy line.
Not reproduced, recorded: goldmark treats neither \f nor \v as blank (util.spaceTable), so lines of only those characters are text in both readers.
Ungated and unchanged: the carriage-return row, 'lost fixed point of a misread' (6, entity rows), 'rewritten bytes of a document base stores incorrectly'.
